day5_ending_true.name: Me
day5_ending_true.text: *And so, my transfer story comes to a close.*

day5_ending_true_2.name: Me
day5_ending_true_2.text: *That one person I met at my new school.*

day5_ending_true_3.name: Me
day5_ending_true_3.text: *From the very first moment until now— my heart never once wavered.*

day5_ending_true_4.name: Me
day5_ending_true_4.text: *I remember. The moment our eyes first met. It felt like time stopped.*

day5_ending_true_5.name: Me
day5_ending_true_5.text: *I didn't know then. That one brief glance would change the direction of my entire life.*

day5_ending_true_6.name: Me
day5_ending_true_6.text: *I can't pinpoint the exact moment I fell in love. I just realized, one day, that I couldn't imagine a tomorrow without them.*

day5_ending_true_7.name: Me
day5_ending_true_7.text: *Like the warmth still lingering on my lips. This feeling won't fade easily.*

day5_ending_true_8.name: Me
day5_ending_true_8.text: *Some would say even feelings like this have an expiration date.*

day5_ending_true_9.name: Me
day5_ending_true_9.text: *But I know better. This isn't something that cools— it's something that seeps deeper.*

day5_ending_true_10.name: Me
day5_ending_true_10.text: *Tomorrow, the day after, even a year from now. I can see myself right here, by this person's side.*

day5_ending_true_11.name: Me
day5_ending_true_11.text: *Let's make a promise. No matter what season comes, we'll stay by each other's side.*

day5_ending_true_12.name: Me
day5_ending_true_12.text: *To love someone completely— that's holding one single certainty amid all the uncertainty in the world.*

day5_ending_good.name: Me
day5_ending_good.text: *And so, my transfer story comes to a close.*

day5_ending_good_faithful_2.name: Me
day5_ending_good_faithful_2.text: *It took a long time to find the courage. But because I waited, this feeling is certain.*

day5_ending_good_faithful_3.name: Me
day5_ending_good_faithful_3.text: *My heart was set from the start. It just took time to put it into words.*

day5_ending_good_faithful_4.name: Me
day5_ending_good_faithful_4.text: *I hesitated because I was afraid of rejection. Afraid this relationship might break.*

day5_ending_good_faithful_5.name: Me
day5_ending_good_faithful_5.text: *But I finally said it. And the answer— was worth the wait.*

day5_ending_good_2.name: Me
day5_ending_good_2.text: *My heart wavered at times, and I made mistakes.*

day5_ending_good_3.name: Me
day5_ending_good_3.text: *But in the end, I found where my true feelings belonged.*

day5_ending_good_4.name: Me
day5_ending_good_4.text: *Looking back, there were times I was careless with someone else's heart.*

day5_ending_good_5.name: Me
day5_ending_good_5.text: *I may have given someone hope only to take it away. I'm sorry for that.*

day5_ending_good_6.name: Me
day5_ending_good_6.text: *But it was because of that wavering that I came to understand what my real feelings are.*

day5_ending_good_7.name: Me
day5_ending_good_7.text: *It doesn't have to be perfect. This is our beginning.*

day5_ending_good_8.name: Me
day5_ending_good_8.text: *I wasn't lost. It was just the journey to finding you.*

day5_ending_good_9.name: Me
day5_ending_good_9.text: *Without the time I spent hesitating, I wouldn't have this certainty now.*

day5_ending_good_10.name: Me
day5_ending_good_10.text: *Imperfect love is still love. Maybe it's even more precious because of the flaws.*

day5_ending_good_11.name: Me
day5_ending_good_11.text: *I'll make mistakes again. We'll clash. But as long as I'm with this person, it'll be okay.*

day5_ending_good_12.name: Me
day5_ending_good_12.text: *So it's alright. It took a long time, and that's exactly why these feelings won't waver easily.*

day5_ending_mayhem.name: Me
day5_ending_mayhem.text: *And so, my transfer story— is it really over?*

day5_ending_mayhem_2.name: Me
day5_ending_mayhem_2.text: *The night sky was too beautiful to gaze at just one star.*

day5_ending_mayhem_3.name: Me
day5_ending_mayhem_3.text: *...Not that excuses will stop them from chasing me.*

day5_ending_mayhem_4.name: Me
day5_ending_mayhem_4.text: *One day, three lunch boxes appeared behind the classroom at the same time. In that moment, I genuinely feared for my life.*

day5_ending_mayhem_5.name: Me
day5_ending_mayhem_5.text: *("Were you with her yesterday?" Seoyeon's icy smile, Yuna's chilling stare, Dain's growling voice. Every day is a survival game.)*

day5_ending_mayhem_6.name: Me
day5_ending_mayhem_6.text: *I seized the chance and escaped to the rooftop. I've never run that fast in my entire life.*

day5_ending_mayhem_7.name: Me
day5_ending_mayhem_7.text: *Just imagining how their eyes would change the moment I pick one sends a chill down my spine.*

day5_ending_mayhem_8.name: Me
day5_ending_mayhem_8.text: *Maybe it's greedy. Wanting to cherish all of them. But it's already too late.*

day5_ending_mayhem_9.name: Me
day5_ending_mayhem_9.text: *Their gazes have already locked around me. There was never anywhere to run in the first place.*

day5_ending_mayhem_10.name: Me
day5_ending_mayhem_10.text: *Honestly... this daily chaos isn't so bad. I wonder what pandemonium tomorrow will bring.*

day5_ending_mayhem_11.name: Me
day5_ending_mayhem_11.text: *Would I make the same choice if I were born again? I won't answer that. But this smile on my face is real.*

day5_ending_mayhem_12.name: Me
day5_ending_mayhem_12.text: *There's no conclusion. But hey— this noisy, chaotic life is my story.*

day5_ending_harem.name: Me
day5_ending_harem.text: *And so, my transfer story— hasn't ended.*

day5_ending_harem_2.name: Me
day5_ending_harem_2.text: *Multiple lovers. An impossible reality sits right in front of me.*

day5_ending_harem_3.name: Me
day5_ending_harem_3.text: *Every day is a war. Daily battles over who gets treated the best.*

day5_ending_harem_4.name: Me
day5_ending_harem_4.text: *Monday's walk to school, Tuesday's lunch, Wednesday's walk home. My weekly schedule is a diplomatic crisis.*

day5_ending_harem_5.name: Me
day5_ending_harem_5.text: *They keep each other in check, yet they've reached a bizarre compromise: if they can't have me exclusively, they'd rather share. This balance could shatter at any moment.*

day5_ending_harem_6.name: Me
day5_ending_harem_6.text: *Each of them is so different. Impossible to compare, impossible to give up.*

day5_ending_harem_7.name: Me
day5_ending_harem_7.text: *Strangely, they're all smiling. As if they own me completely.*

day5_ending_harem_8.name: Me
day5_ending_harem_8.text: *Call it greed if you want. If I can't escape this, then so be it.*

day5_ending_harem_9.name: Me
day5_ending_harem_9.text: *No regrets. Actually, they don't even give me time to regret. They're watching my every move.*

day5_ending_harem_10.name: Me
day5_ending_harem_10.text: *The moment this balance breaks, there'll be hell to pay. Who'll be the first to cross the line?*

day5_ending_harem_11.name: Me
day5_ending_harem_11.text: *A sweet kind of hell. Caught between dizzying thrill and dread, I can't get out. No— I don't want to get out.*

day5_ending_harem_12.name: Me
day5_ending_harem_12.text: *Tomorrow I'll be watched again. The day after, the grip will tighten. But— these days, I accept them.*

day5_ending_friend.name: Me
day5_ending_friend.text: *And so, my transfer story comes to a close.*

day5_ending_friend_2.name: Me
day5_ending_friend_2.text: *I couldn't say what I felt. No— I chose not to.*

day5_ending_friend_3.name: Me
day5_ending_friend_3.text: (The feelings I hid behind the word "friend" might surface on some quiet night.)

day5_ending_friend_4.name: Me
day5_ending_friend_4.text: *I remember. On the rooftop, their fingertips brushing the hair the wind blew across their face.*

day5_ending_friend_5.name: Me
day5_ending_friend_5.text: (If I'd said "I like you" back then, would tonight be any different?)

day5_ending_friend_6.name: Me
day5_ending_friend_6.text: *Words left unsaid don't disappear. They just glow quietly, deep inside.*

day5_ending_friend_7.name: Me
day5_ending_friend_7.text: *Sometimes the closest distance is also the farthest. The distance called "friends."*

day5_ending_friend_8.name: Me
day5_ending_friend_8.text: *Still, it's not so bad. I can see them smiling right beside me.*

day5_ending_friend_9.name: Me
day5_ending_friend_9.text: *Maybe it's cowardice, or maybe it's caution. I just didn't want to lose what we had.*

day5_ending_friend_10.name: Me
day5_ending_friend_10.text: *I don't regret it. It's just that sometimes, that sunset comes back to me.*

day5_ending_friend_11.name: Me
day5_ending_friend_11.text: *The words that lingered on the tip of my tongue, then got swallowed— they won't vanish. They'll quietly etch their rings inside me, year after year.*

day5_ending_friend_12.name: Me
day5_ending_friend_12.text: *Some stories linger longer precisely because they're left unfinished. This season will be remembered that way.*

day5_ending_alone.name: Me
day5_ending_alone.text: *And so, my transfer story comes to a close.*

day5_ending_alone_2.name: Me
day5_ending_alone_2.text: *No one special came along. But the time I spent at this school wasn't wasted.*

day5_ending_alone_3.name: Me
day5_ending_alone_3.text: *I've changed from who I was before the transfer, when I felt like I couldn't do anything.*

day5_ending_alone_4.name: Me
day5_ending_alone_4.text: *What I learned here wasn't about romance. It was about facing myself.*

day5_ending_alone_5.name: Me
day5_ending_alone_5.text: *The laughter in the classroom, the chatter between classes, the sunlight during P.E. Ordinary things that turned out to matter.*

day5_ending_alone_6.name: Me
day5_ending_alone_6.text: *Solitude isn't a punishment. It's time spent face to face with yourself.*

day5_ending_alone_7.name: Me
day5_ending_alone_7.text: *I learned that before you can love someone, you have to understand yourself first.*

day5_ending_alone_8.name: Me
day5_ending_alone_8.text: *Being alone doesn't mean being lonely. Some things you can only hear when it's just you.*

day5_ending_alone_9.name: Me
day5_ending_alone_9.text: *The sound of the wind, my footsteps, my own heartbeat. In that rhythm, I was slowly getting to know myself.*

day5_ending_alone_10.name: Me
day5_ending_alone_10.text: *Even if I didn't reach anyone, these moments aren't meaningless.*

day5_ending_alone_11.name: Me
day5_ending_alone_11.text: *There's no need to rush. I can walk at my own pace, on my own path.*
